{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm to ensure clean mean calculation
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Group by species and compute mean flipper length
grouped = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
sorted_grouped = grouped.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Print the mean flipper lengths for all species to ensure all evidence is from actual output
print(sorted_grouped)

# Extract and print the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = sorted_grouped.iloc[0]['species']
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}")

# Print the mean flipper length for Gentoo (the highest) to use in evidence
highest_mean = sorted_grouped.iloc[0]['flipper_length_mm']
print(f"Mean flipper length for Gentoo: {highest_mean}")

# Print mean flipper lengths for Chinstrap and Adelie for completeness
chinstrap_mean = sorted_grouped.iloc[1]['flipper_length_mm']
adelie_mean = sorted_grouped.iloc[2]['flipper_length_mm']
print(f"Mean flipper length for Chinstrap: {chinstrap_mean}")
print(f"Mean flipper length for Adelie: {adelie_mean}")"}
